definitions.core_principle: An own-sign or exalted planet's dasa is a yoga, not a dosha. When it touches the 6th or 10th it forces a career change - frightening because of running commitments, but the change pushes the native to a bigger next step (better job, own business, new gateway).
definitions.trigger_set: Dasa (or bhukti) of: (a) the own/exalted planet itself, (b) a planet sitting in its nakshatra, or (c) a planet conjoined with it.
definitions.exceptions: Change may not happen if the own/exalted planet is retrograde, or its dispositor is debilitated.
definitions.false_dignity: In ~10-15% of charts an own/exalted planet is 'China-piece' strength - looks dignified but is undermined (retrograde, combust/afflicted, dispositor weak, conjoined planets debilitated). Then the dasa can hurt. Always verify before predicting.
definitions.dasa_gate: Only acts in the relevant dasa/bhukti.

rules.name: Own/exalted planet in 6th or 10th - career change
rules.condition: planet own/exalted in 6th or 10th from lagna, AND a trigger_set dasa/bhukti begins
rules.result: Job/business change is near-certain. Outcome positive in ~90%: the native is pushed out of a comfortable rut into a better role, income or own venture.
rules.for_business_owners: Expect added investment, renovation/reform of the business, new product lines, new marketing strategy - and success after it.
rules.transition_note: Some turbulence until the planet's own bhukti (swa-bhukti) ends; growth after that.

rules.name: Own/exalted planet in lagna - ego and dignity
rules.condition: own/exalted planet in lagna, its dasa running
rules.result: Strong sense of self-respect/status (strongest with Jupiter own/exalted in lagna). Tends to quit jobs over lack of respect or recognition.
rules.advice_output: Suggest humility and flexibility at work; stay focused on the goal (earning, family security) rather than recognition.
rules.note: Benefic in lagna raises dignity even more than Saturn or Mars there.

rules.name: Fear vs reality check
rules.method: When a native fears an upcoming own-sign dasa, check: is it in 6/10 (career change, positive)? Is the planet in mutual yogas (e.g. Jupiter-Venus, Gajakesari, Budhaditya, own-sign 3rd lord)? Is it retrograde or is its dispositor weak? Only the last case justifies fear.
rules.example: Meena lagna, Venus own sign in 3rd with Jupiter, Sun, Mercury; Moon opposite: multiple yogas -> Venus dasa a yoga dasa (property, house, car, jewellery, status). Had Venus been retrograde, the whole cluster would fail.

rules.name: Ketu dasa in 6th failing
rules.condition: Ketu in 6th but its deciding authorities (sign lord + star lord) are 6/8 from each other
rules.result: Ketu dasa difficult despite the textbook 'nodes in 6th = good' rule.

rules.name: Own-sign planet in 3rd
rules.result: Classical verse: strong 3rd lord / own-sign 3rd brings ornaments, clothes, property, comforts.

rules.name: Retrograde own-sign planet in a stellium
rules.result: If the own-sign anchor of a multi-planet cluster is retrograde, all the cluster's yogas collapse.

engine_output_suggestion.career_alert: For each upcoming dasa/bhukti in trigger_set touching 6th/10th own/exalted planets: emit 'career change likely - positive direction', with start date, and append exceptions if retrograde/dispositor weak.

open_questions_for_implementation: Concrete test for 'false dignity' (which afflictions count)
Does OE-01 apply to bhukti as strongly as to dasa? (Speaker implies yes for job change.)
